Command has ordered you to take out their leader, a nasty Twi'lek named Yorn Nuro.|Boss, to a [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Clone Wars)|Jedi Knight]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)">[[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']]</ref>}}
'''Yorn Nuro''' was the [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] leader of the [[Nuro pirates/Legends|Nuro Pirates]]. Supporting the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Third battle of Felucia]], the pirates captured a [[Nysillin farm (Nuro Pirates)|Nysillin farm]] and started supplying the [[Nysillin/Legends|nysillin]] to the Confederacy. During the battle, the famed [[Clone commando/Legends|Clone Commando]] [[Boss (clone commando)/Legends|Boss]] commissioned a [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Clone Wars)|Jedi Knight]] to defeat Yorn, which was successfully carried out.
